dex.fr: Ses plantes de pieds sont couvertes d’épines lui permettant de marcher au mur et au plafond.
dex.en: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This POKéMON attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.

dex.fr: Il vit dans les jungles denses. Il saute de branche en branche pour approcher de sa proie.
dex.en: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This POKéMON is a master at climbing trees in jungles.

dex.fr: Les feuilles sur ses bras peuvent trancher des troncs épais. C’est le meilleur combattant des jungles.
dex.en: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body are very sharp edged. This POKéMON is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.

dex.fr: Ses câlins réchauffent car il renferme une fournaise. Il envoie des boules de feu à 1 000 °C.
dex.en: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This POKéMON breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.

dex.fr: Ce maître du coup de pied peut donner 10 coups par seconde. Ses cris aigus intimident l’ennemi.
dex.en: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This POKéMON’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.

dex.fr: Des flammes fusent de ses poignets et ses coups brûlent l’ennemi.
dex.en: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this POKéMON’s wrists burn.

dex.fr: Il analyse le courant grâce à la nageoire sur sa tête. Il est assez fort pour soulever des rochers.
dex.en: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this POKéMON can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.

dex.fr: Ses jambes robustes lui donnent un bon appui, même dans la boue. Il dort enfoui dans la saleté.
dex.en: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.

dex.fr: Il peut traîner un grand bateau en nageant. Il assomme l’ennemi d’un grand coup de ses bras épais.
dex.en: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This POKéMON also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.

dex.fr: Un Pokémon très obstiné qui poursuit sa proie jusqu’à ce qu’elle soit épuisée.
dex.en: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This POKéMON chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.

dex.fr: Il traque ses proies en groupe. Il ne désobéira jamais aux ordres d’un bon Dresseur.
dex.en: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This POKéMON will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.

dex.fr: Il marche en zigzaguant et n’a pas son pareil pour trouver des objets dans l’herbe ou sous terre.
dex.en: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This POKéMON does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.

dex.fr: Il fonce sur sa proie à plus de 100 km/h. Mais il ne peut pas dévier sa course et loupe souvent sa cible.
dex.en: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This POKéMON is very challenged by gently curving roads.

dex.fr: Cible favorite des Pokémon Oiseaux, il tente de se protéger avec ses épines venimeuses.
dex.en: Using the spikes on its rear end, WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This POKéMON’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.

dex.fr: Il attend d’évoluer dans son cocon de soie accroché aux branches et se nourrit d’eau de pluie.
dex.en: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this POKéMON hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.

dex.fr: Malgré les apparences, il est très agressif et attaque avec sa trompe quand on le dérange.
dex.en: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this POKéMON, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.

dex.fr: Rancunier, il n’oublie aucune des attaques subies dans le cocon et se venge une fois qu’il a évolué.
dex.en: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This POKéMON prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.

dex.fr: Il disperse un nuage de poudre toxique à chaque coup d’aile. Il aime les feuilles d’arbres urbains.
dex.en: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this POKéMON are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.

dex.fr: Il ressemble à une plante aquatique et fait la navette pour les Pokémon qui ne savent pas nager.
dex.en: LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this POKéMON travels on land in search of clean water.

dex.fr: C’est un mauvais plaisantin. Quand il repère un pêcheur, il tire sur sa ligne pour le déranger.
dex.en: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief-maker. When this POKéMON spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.

dex.fr: Ses muscles se tonifient au son d’une musique entraînante. Il ne peut pas s’empêcher de danser.
dex.en: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This POKéMON is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.

dex.fr: Il ressemble à un gland pendu à une branche. Il adore effrayer les autres Pokémon.
dex.en: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this POKéMON’s body becomes.

dex.fr: Le son de sa flûte d’herbe déstabilise l’auditeur. Il vit au plus profond des forêts.
dex.en: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This POKéMON dislikes having its long nose pinched.

dex.fr: D’un coup de sa feuille éventail, il génère des bourrasques de 30 m/s capables de souffler une maison.
dex.en: SHIFTRY is a mysterious POKéMON that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.

dex.fr: Ce Pokémon téméraire n’a pas peur d’affronter des ennemis puissants. Il vole en quête de climats chauds.
dex.en: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy POKéMON will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

dex.fr: Il vole en cercle en quête d’une proie. Dès qu’il l’a repérée, il fond sur elle en un éclair.
dex.en: SWELLOW flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This POKéMON dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’s clawed feet, preventing escape.

dex.fr: Il utilise les courants ascendants pour planer en altitude. Son bec lui sert à transporter la nourriture.
dex.en: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This POKéMON rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.

dex.fr: Ce messager du ciel transporte petits Pokémon et œufs dans son bec en toute sécurité.
dex.en: PELIPPER is a flying transporter that carries small POKéMON and eggs inside its massive bill. This POKéMON builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.

dex.fr: Quand ses cornes captent les ondes positives d’un Pokémon ou d’un humain, son corps se réchauffe.
dex.en: RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This POKéMON rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.

dex.fr: Quand il sent la joie de son Dresseur, il se met à danser, débordant d’énergie.
dex.en: It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This POKéMON controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.

dex.fr: Prêt à tout pour protéger son Dresseur, il peut créer un mini trou noir par sa seule force mentale.
dex.en: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its TRAINER, this POKéMON is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.

dex.fr: Il semble patiner sur l’eau. Le parfum diffusé par le sommet de sa tête sert à attirer ses proies.
dex.en: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.

dex.fr: Des motifs en forme d’yeux ornent ses antennes. Ses 4 ailes l’aident à voler dans toutes les directions.
dex.en: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This POKéMON flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.

dex.fr: Le sommet de sa tête libère des spores empoisonnées. Il est dangereux de les inhaler.
dex.en: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This POKéMON feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.

dex.fr: Ses petits bras s’étendent quand il donne un coup de poing. Son talent égale celui d’un boxeur pro.
dex.en: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This POKéMON’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.

dex.fr: Il passe le plus clair de son temps affalé. Rien qu’à le voir, on a envie de bâiller.
dex.en: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This POKéMON’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.

dex.fr: Son cœur bat dix fois plus vite que la normale, c’est pourquoi il ne tient pas en place.
dex.en: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This POKéMON’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.

dex.fr: Le Pokémon le plus fainéant du monde. Il s’allonge pour économiser ses forces et contre-attaquer.
dex.en: SLAKING spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this POKéMON reluctantly moves to another spot.

dex.fr: Il grandit sous terre et se repère grâce à ses antennes car ses yeux sont quasiment aveugles.
dex.en: NINCADA lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This POKéMON absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.

dex.fr: Il bouge si vite que l’œil a parfois du mal à le suivre. Ils se regroupent près de la sève des arbres.
dex.en: NINJASK moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this POKéMON was long believed to be invisible.

dex.fr: Une carapace d’insecte laissée à l’abandon. On dit qu’il vole l’âme de celui qui regarde à l’intérieur.
dex.en: SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this POKéMON will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.

dex.fr: En temps normal, son cri est pareil à un murmure. Effrayé, il atteint le volume d’un avion à réaction.
dex.en: Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this POKéMON senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.

dex.fr: L’onde de choc provoquée par son cri peut renverser un camion. Il trépigne pour augmenter sa force.
dex.en: LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This POKéMON’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.

dex.fr: Son hurlement s’entend à 10 km à la ronde. Ses orifices émettent toutes sortes de bruits.
dex.en: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this POKéMON violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.

dex.fr: Il fortifie son corps en fonçant sur des arbres épais. Son nid est entouré d’arbres abattus.
dex.en: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this POKéMON stores more energy in its body for evolving.

dex.fr: Il aime mesurer sa force à celle des plus grands Pokémon. Ses coups de paume peuvent projeter un camion.
dex.en: HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this POKéMON’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.

dex.fr: Sa queue est plus rebondissante qu’une balle du même nom. C’est aussi une massue très puissante.
dex.en: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these POKéMON managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.

dex.fr: Face au danger, il se protège en augmentant son magnétisme et en attirant tout objet métallique.
dex.en: NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these POKéMON meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.

dex.fr: Il poursuit tout ce qui bouge. On le voit parfois courir en cercle, chassant sa propre queue.
dex.en: SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This POKéMON is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.

dex.fr: Les femmes Dresseurs raffolent de sa sublime fourrure. Il ne possède pas de nid.
dex.en: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.

dex.fr: À force de manger des gemmes, les yeux de ce Pokémon des grottes obscures sont devenus des joyaux.
dex.en: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these POKéMON are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.

dex.fr: Ses cornes forment une grande mâchoire attachée à sa tête. Elle peut broyer des barres de fer.
dex.en: MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.

dex.fr: Il vit habituellement au cœur des montagnes. Affamé, il dévore parfois des rails et des voitures.
dex.en: This POKéMON has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.

dex.fr: Il se nourrit du minerai de fer qu’il fore. Il défend son territoire en chargeant avec son corps d’acier.
dex.en: LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This POKéMON makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.

dex.fr: Il creuse des galeries à travers la pierre avec ses cornes d’acier pour trouver le fer qu’il apprécie.
dex.en: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This POKéMON vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.

dex.fr: Son entraînement d’ermite lui permet de léviter par le seul pouvoir de la méditation.
dex.en: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this POKéMON always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.

dex.fr: Le jeûne lui permet de concentrer son esprit au point de déceler l’aura de ses adversaires.
dex.en: It is said that through meditation, MEDICHAM heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This POKéMON hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.

dex.fr: Il améliore ses réflexes en stimulant ses muscles grâce à l’électricité dans sa fourrure.
dex.en: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This POKéMON stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.

dex.fr: Il libère l’électricité par sa crinière. Il crée un nuage d’orage pour appeler la foudre.
dex.en: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this POKéMON creates thunderclouds.

dex.fr: Il absorbe l’énergie des poteaux électriques et encourage ses amis avec des pompons d’étincelles.
dex.en: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this POKéMON shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.

dex.fr: Il encourage ses amis. Son corps produit plus d’étincelles quand il est en mauvaise posture.
dex.en: MINUN is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.

dex.fr: Il communique avec ses pairs en allumant son postérieur la nuit. Il adore le doux parfum de Lumivole.
dex.en: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This POKéMON is attracted by the sweet aroma of ILLUMISE.

dex.fr: Il utilise son doux parfum pour aider Muciole à décrire des arabesques dans le ciel nocturne.
dex.en: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT using a sweet fragrance. Once the VOLBEAT have gathered, this POKéMON leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.

dex.fr: Plus le Rosélia est en bonne santé et plus son parfum est agréable et relaxant pour son entourage.
dex.en: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this POKéMON brings serenity to living things.

dex.fr: Il est principalement composé d’un estomac dont les sucs digestifs dissolvent tout ce qu’il avale.
dex.en: Virtually all of GULPIN’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This POKéMON’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.

dex.fr: Il avale tout en une bouchée. Ses follicules sécrètent des fluides toxiques qui endorment l’ennemi.
dex.en: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this POKéMON gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.

dex.fr: Il attaque en banc quand on menace son territoire. Ses dents aiguisées peuvent couler un navire.
dex.en: CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this POKéMON.

dex.fr: Ses crocs lacèrent des feuilles d’acier. Il nage à 120 km/h. On l’appelle “tyran des mers”.
dex.en: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” SHARPEDO is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these POKéMON can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.

dex.fr: Par beau temps, il se pose sur les plages pour jouer et rebondir. Il expulse de l’eau par son évent.
dex.en: WAILMER’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful POKéMON loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.

dex.fr: Le plus grand des Pokémon. Il peut plonger à une profondeur de 3 000 m en retenant son souffle.
dex.en: WAILORD is the largest of all identified POKéMON up to now. This giant POKéMON swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.

dex.fr: Son dos bossu renferme une lave bouillonnante. Elle refroidit par temps de pluie, ce qui le ralentit.
dex.en: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This POKéMON’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.

dex.fr: Il porte des volcans sur son dos. Quand le magma remonte, il frissonne et entre en éruption.
dex.en: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this POKéMON’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.

dex.fr: Il tire son énergie du charbon qu’il brûle dans sa carapace et crache de la suie noire en cas de danger.
dex.en: TORKOAL digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this POKéMON spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.

dex.fr: Il utilise sa queue comme un ressort et bondit partout. Chaque nouveau choc fait battre son cœur.
dex.en: SPOINK bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this POKéMON cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it stops, its heart will stop.

dex.fr: Les perles noires amplifient ses pouvoirs psy. Sa danse étrange lui permet de contrôler ses ennemis.
dex.en: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this POKéMON uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.

dex.fr: Les motifs sur leur fourrure sont propres à chaque Spinda. Son pas chancelant le rend difficile à viser.
dex.en: All the SPINDA that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this POKéMON give it the appearance of dancing.

dex.fr: Il creuse un trou conique dans le sable du désert et se terre en attendant qu’une proie trébuche.
dex.en: TRAPINCH’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This POKéMON patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.

dex.fr: Ses violents battements d’ailes génèrent des vagues d’ultrasons qui donnent mal au crâne.
dex.en: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This POKéMON’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.

dex.fr: Son puissant battement d’ailes provoque des tempêtes de sable. On l’appelle “esprit du désert”.
dex.en: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this POKéMON is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.

dex.fr: En stockant l’eau dans son corps, cet habitant du désert peut survivre 30 jours sans boire.
dex.en: CACNEA lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this POKéMON shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.

dex.fr: Il sort la nuit pour chasser. Il traque les proies épuisées après une journée dans le désert.
dex.en: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This POKéMON becomes active at night when the temperature drops.

dex.fr: Il ne se sent à l’aise que dans un milieu propre et repousse la poussière avec ses ailes.
dex.en: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This POKéMON is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.

dex.fr: Il aime enlacer ses amis dans ses ailes cotonneuses et ronronner.
dex.en: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this POKéMON makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.

dex.fr: C’est le rival de Séviper depuis des générations. Ses griffes aiguisées sont son meilleur atout.
dex.en: Memories of battling its arch-rival SEVIPER are etched into every cell of ZANGOOSE’s body. This POKéMON adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.

dex.fr: Le rival historique de Mangriff. Il affûte la lame de sa queue sur les rochers avant le combat.
dex.en: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This POKéMON attacks using its sword- edged tail.

dex.fr: On suppose qu’il est lié au cycle lunaire, car il ne sort que les soirs de pleine lune.
dex.en: LUNATONE was discovered at a location where a meteorite fell. As a result, some people theorize that this POKéMON came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.

dex.fr: Le bruit court que cette nouvelle espèce vient du soleil. Il produit de la lumière en tournoyant.
dex.en: SOLROCK is a new species of POKéMON that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this POKéMON releases intensely bright light.

dex.fr: Son corps glissant est difficile à attraper. On dit qu’il a été créé dans de la boue solidifiée.
dex.en: BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This POKéMON hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.

dex.fr: Il défend férocement son territoire en déclenchant des secousses terribles.
dex.en: WHISCASH is extremely territorial. Just one of these POKéMON will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.

dex.fr: Sa nature robuste lui permet de vivre sur n’importe quel terrain. Ses pinces ne lâchent jamais prise.
dex.en: CORPHISH were originally foreign POKéMON that were imported as pets. They eventually turned up in the wild. This POKéMON is very hardy and has greatly increased its population.

dex.fr: C’est un voyou qui utilise ses pinces pour chasser les autres Pokémon hors de sa mare.
dex.en: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this POKéMON, making them desolate places.

dex.fr: Il se déplace en tournoyant sur son pied. Ce Pokémon rare fut découvert dans de vieilles ruines.
dex.en: BALTOY moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this POKéMON living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.

dex.fr: Une ancienne figurine d’argile qui s’est animée suite à son exposition à un rayon de lumière étrange.
dex.en: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This POKéMON moves about while levitating.

dex.fr: Il vivait au fond de la mer il y a 100 millions d’années. La science a permis de le ressusciter.
dex.en: LILEEP became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient POKéMON attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.

dex.fr: Vit dans les hauts-fonds des mers chaudes. Il déterre sa proie du sable quand la marée se retire.
dex.en: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This POKéMON freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.

dex.fr: Un ancêtre Pokémon réanimé à partir d’un fossile. Il vivait en mer et chassait avec ses pinces.
dex.en: ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive POKéMON once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.

dex.fr: Il a gagné la côte après son évolution. Une armure robuste recouvre son corps.
dex.en: ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This POKéMON’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.

dex.fr: Ce Pokémon a peut-être un physique disgracieux, mais il est robuste et peut survivre dans très peu d’eau.
dex.en: FEEBAS’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this POKéMON is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.

dex.fr: Ses splendides écailles aux couleurs de l’arc-en-ciel changent de teinte selon l’angle de vue.
dex.en: MILOTIC is said to be the most beautiful of all the POKéMON. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.

dex.fr: Son aspect change avec la météo. On a récemment découvert que ses molécules étaient pareilles à l’eau.
dex.en: CASTFORM’s appearance changes with the weather. This POKéMON gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.

dex.fr: Il change de couleur à volonté, mais le motif en zigzag qui orne son ventre reste le même.
dex.en: KECLEON is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception - this POKéMON can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.

dex.fr: Il aime le goût de la vengeance. Ils vivent en rangs sous les gouttières des gens vindicatifs.
dex.en: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this POKéMON will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.

dex.fr: Une poupée mue par la tristesse qui la ronge depuis qu’on l’a délaissée. Elle recherche son propriétaire.
dex.en: BANETTE generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This POKéMON was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.

dex.fr: Les cris des enfants l’amusent. Il effraie les moins sages d’entre eux en traversant les murs.
dex.en: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this POKéMON chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.

dex.fr: Il cherche des feux follets pour les avaler. Ce qui se passe alors dans son corps est un mystère.
dex.en: DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.

dex.fr: À force de toujours manger le même fruit succulent, il en pousse à la base de son cou.
dex.en: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS’s neck are very popular with children. This POKéMON loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.

dex.fr: Ses cris se répercutent dans son corps creux avant d’exploser en notes mélodieuses et saisissantes.
dex.en: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this POKéMON becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.

dex.fr: La capacité de sa corne à sentir les catastrophes ayant trop attiré l’attention sur lui, il vit reclus.
dex.en: Every time ABSOL appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster POKéMON.

dex.fr: Il se muscle en bousculant ses semblables lors de mêlées. Il raffole des fruits sucrés.
dex.en: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this POKéMON will be slapping the ground with its tail.

dex.fr: On dit que des groupes entiers de Stalgamin vivent en harmonie sous des feuilles gigantesques.
dex.en: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this POKéMON steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.

dex.fr: Il empêche ses proies de prendre la fuite en gelant instantanément l’humidité de l’air.
dex.en: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This POKéMON has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.

dex.fr: Il gagne la côte en roulant sur les blocs de glace car sa morphologie n’est pas adaptée à la nage.
dex.en: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this POKéMON eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.

dex.fr: Il fait souvent tourner des objets sur son museau pour connaître leur odeur et leur texture.
dex.en: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This POKéMON occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL on its nose.

dex.fr: Il brise la glace avec ses grosses défenses. Sa graisse le protège du froid, mais aussi des attaques.
dex.en: WALREIN’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing ten tons with one blow. This POKéMON’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.

dex.fr: Il ne produit qu’une perle durant son existence. On raconte qu’elle amplifie les pouvoirs psychiques.
dex.en: CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.

dex.fr: Il vit loin sous la mer. Il appâte les proies crédules avec sa queue qui rappelle un petit poisson.
dex.en: HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This POKéMON’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.

dex.fr: Au printemps, son corps rose se fait plus vif sans que l’on sache pourquoi. Il vit au fond de la mer.
dex.en: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this POKéMON’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.

dex.fr: Un Pokémon rare aperçu lors d’une exploration sous-marine. Il n’a pas évolué depuis 100 millions d’années.
dex.en: RELICANTH is a POKéMON species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.

dex.fr: Un habitant des mers chaudes. On dit que le couple qui tombe sur ce Pokémon connaîtra l’amour éternel.
dex.en: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped POKéMON earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.

dex.fr: Il rêve de pouvoir voler un jour. Pour l’heure, il s’entraîne en sautant du haut des falaises.
dex.en: BAGON has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this POKéMON hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.

dex.fr: Ses cellules ont commencé à changer dans sa robuste coquille. Il la perd en évoluant.
dex.en: Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This POKéMON’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.

dex.fr: À force de rêver de pouvoir voler, sa structure cellulaire a évolué et il s’est vu pousser des ailes.
dex.en: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this POKéMON’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.

dex.fr: Il dialogue avec les siens par impulsions magnétiques. En bande, ils se déplacent à l’unisson.
dex.en: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This POKéMON communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.

dex.fr: Il est formé de deux Terhal soudés. Son corps de fer résiste à un choc avec un avion à réaction.
dex.en: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this POKéMON generates strong psychokinetic power.

dex.fr: Il est né de la fusion de plusieurs Métang. Ses quatre cerveaux en font l’égal d’un superordinateur.
dex.en: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This POKéMON can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.

dex.fr: Tout son corps est fait de roche. S’il s’ébrèche au combat, il utilise des pierres pour le réparer.
dex.en: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this POKéMON’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.

dex.fr: Son corps est fait de glace datant de l’ère glaciaire. Il contrôle un air gelé de -200 °C.
dex.en: REGICE’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This POKéMON controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.

dex.fr: Son corps invulnérable fut forgé par la pression souterraine durant des dizaines de milliers d’années.
dex.en: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this POKéMON eats.

dex.fr: Son corps est recouvert d’un duvet qui reflète la lumière et le rend invisible.
dex.en: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this POKéMON ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.

dex.fr: Un Pokémon très intelligent. Il peut voler plus vite qu’un avion à réaction en repliant ses ailes.
dex.en: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This POKéMON is intelligent and understands human speech.

dex.fr: On dit qu’il a fait monter les eaux en causant des pluies diluviennes. Il somnolait dans une fosse marine.
dex.en: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This POKéMON saved people who were suffering from droughts.

dex.fr: Il dormait dans le magma souterrain depuis sa lutte féroce contre Kyogre, il y a longtemps de cela.
dex.en: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the POKéMON that raised lands and expanded continents. This POKéMON took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.

dex.fr: Il vit dans la couche d’ozone, au dessus des nuages. Il est invisible depuis le sol.
dex.en: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This POKéMON appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.

dex.fr: On raconte qu’une fois tous les mille ans, il a la capacité d’exaucer tous les vœux durant une semaine.
dex.en: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this POKéMON senses danger, it will fight without awakening.

dex.fr: Il vient d’un virus extraterrestre arrivé avec une météorite et ayant subi une mutation génétique.
dex.en: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’s chest appears to be its brain.
